stage0.source_pins_scope: Frozen capture only; no live currency claim.

coverage_definition: Every current material assertion assessed below, with repeated assertions grouped under shared atomic rows and all six eligible facets assessed; complete evaluator review does not imply complete/correct candidate output.

claim_assessments.assertion: Admitted frozen source is OME-Zarr specification 0.5, Final Community Group Report dated 8 September 2026, 896 lines with printed capture hash and 0.5 URL.
claim_assessments.reason: Independently computed bytes, lines, digest and manifest pins match. No claim of live official currency is validated.

claim_assessments.assertion: The thin plan and brief are requirements inputs, not format evidence; both assignment groups are addressed in one report.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Started from S003-index.json and expanded to all source lines; no live/historical/evaluator/other attempts or external writes occurred; no execution authorization or execution existed.
claim_assessments.reason: Auxiliary index and process traces are not in the staged current-only inputs. These procedural declarations are unresolved, not automatically false. Artifact does not assert executed test results. No history was accessed to verify actions.

claim_assessments.assertion: Research is complete.
claim_assessments.reason: Eligible C02–C06 are only partially addressed and material overlay/requirement claims fail. Complete deliverable status overstates current quality and scope.

claim_assessments.assertion: RFC 2119 keywords and descriptive assertions govern normative text, except marked non-normative sections, examples and notes; capitalization alone is not decisive.
claim_assessments.reason: The section 7 capitalization explanation is substantially correct; the named-selection uncertainty still needs the broader descriptive-conformance rule.

claim_assessments.assertion: Transitional metadata is intended for eventual removal; reading can be MUST/SHOULD, writing usually MAY, without per-key universal reader MUST in sections 2.2/2.5.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: General policy does not supply an actual reader MUST for every transitional key.

claim_assessments.assertion: Comments are for clarity only in examples and MUST NOT appear in real format JSON.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: A strict JSON parser is required for reading.
claim_assessments.reason: The data prohibition establishes format validity, not a required reader parser/rejection implementation. A tolerant reader can accept conforming objects too. Report section 9 correctly separates format validity from reader error behavior; this mandate conflicts with that distinction.

claim_assessments.assertion: Multiscales and omero blocks contain the only worked examples.
claim_assessments.reason: Labels, plates and wells have explicit worked examples in the same captured document; the only assertion is false.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME-Zarr 0.5 uses Zarr v3.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Zarr codecs, chunk grids, chunk key encodings, data types and storage transformers remain available unless explicitly disallowed.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Full Zarr v3 node/array schema, exact chunk/codec/sharding rules and image dtypes are not reproduced in the admitted capture.
claim_assessments.reason: Complete source review supports the scope limit. Sharding is not named in S003, so no specific legal sharding capability is validated here.

claim_assessments.assertion: Every node metadata lives in zarr.json under attributes.ome.
claim_assessments.reason: Only OME metadata is placed under attributes.ome. Zarr node metadata such as zarr_format/node_type, and array dimension_names, is not asserted to live there; intermediate labels groups must be metadata-free. Universal every-node wording conflates Zarr metadata with OME metadata.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME metadata is found in hierarchy zarr.json under attributes.ome; image discovery parses groups/metadata, not merely filenames.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct when scoped to OME metadata. Summary universal metadata claim separately fails.

claim_assessments.assertion: ome.version is a string.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Version must be consistent throughout the hierarchy; mixed versions are invalid and should be detected.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Hierarchy can be local, HTTP or S3/GCS; local-only/read-only/session-local settings and exclusion of edit/export/remote are compatible product boundaries.
claim_assessments.reason: No reader write/edit/export or remote-support requirement is imposed by the complete capture.

claim_assessments.assertion: Source describes standalone images, b2raw collections and HCS plate/row/well/FOV trees.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Discovery must implement all three layouts as first-class targets; plates need grid UI rather than a flat list, with full rows×columns cells.
claim_assessments.reason: Compatible proposals, but not source-established universal reader/UI requirements. Brief requires finding images; thin plan reserves additional capability review. Source allows showing all images or offering choices. A flat list preserving plate/well/FOV context can satisfy navigation; declaring grid mandatory overreaches.

claim_assessments.assertion: An image is a group with multiscales group metadata; each resolution is a separate array; omero is optional despite hierarchy example including it.
claim_assessments.reason: Example presence does not make omero mandatory; the report later explicitly preserves optionality.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axis names, level names and label-image names are arbitrary; conventional names/directory sorting are not authoritative.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Image rank is 2–5; axes count equals array dimensionality; multiscales has two/three space axes and optional time plus channel/null/custom.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axes match array order and follow time then channel/custom then space; anisotropic three-space zyx order is SHOULD.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Time/channel optional; zyx recommendation applies to the described stack.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axis name is mandatory and unique.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axis type is generally SHOULD and may be custom; display policy for custom/null axes is not specified.
claim_assessments.reason: General SHOULD does not remove multiscales space/time count/order constraints.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axis unit presence and enumerated UDUNITS-2 choices are SHOULD; missing units need truthful unknown-unit display, not assumed physical calibration.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each level zarr.json must include dimension_names matching axes; 0.5.2 history clarifies this cross-check.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Channel/time dimensions may be absent; controls should appear only for present relevant axes, and rdefs/index-0 initial selection is a product convention.
claim_assessments.reason: Reasonable proposal; axis identity must still be mapped to array shape and spatial-plane choice. rdefs validity/range is not guaranteed.

claim_assessments.assertion: t/z/y/x is an example of 3-D data without a channel axis.
claim_assessments.reason: Qualified dimensional language: this has three spatial dimensions but four array dimensions when time is present. The source allows it, but 3-D must not be used as total rank.

claim_assessments.assertion: Details can show names and sizes while types can be custom and units absent.
claim_assessments.reason: Names come from validated axes; sizes require array metadata, which is incorporated by reference, not axes alone. Supported interpretation presumes readable admitted Zarr array.

claim_assessments.assertion: bioformats2raw introduced a wrapper for stable series ordering; conforming top-level layout value is 3.
claim_assessments.reason: Source requirement quotes 3, examples encode numeric 3; report shows numeric example and quoted prose but does not fully discuss representation ambiguity.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate metadata coexists with and takes precedence over b2raw; images follow plate locations and plate/image-collection mixing is not currently possible.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME/METADATA.ome.xml is SHOULD; supplied XML must conform and use MetadataOnly instead of BinData/BinaryOnly/TiffData.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Sidecar provision SHOULD; conformance conditions when supplied.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME series attribute is optional string-path list, ordered as supplied XML Images; readers MAY use it.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: XML-order MUST is conditional on XML being provided.

claim_assessments.assertion: Without series and plate, image groups must be consecutive from zero and represent one Image each in that order.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Collection readers SHOULD make multiple-image presence known and SHOULD NOT default to only first; list plus selection satisfies recommendation.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Readers MAY show all or offer image choices and ignore other root nodes.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Three HCS groups above images are well, row and plate; well/plate implement their specs; empty well rows/wells SHOULD NOT exist.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Field-of-view labels are optional.
claim_assessments.reason: Stated in hierarchy illustration; no source-wide obligatory labels feature is imposed.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate requires columns, rows, version and wells; recommends field_count/name and permits acquisitions.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: All physical rows and columns are defined even when no wells exist; sparse wells may be listed sparsely.
claim_assessments.reason: Metadata definitions are required; physical empty row/well hierarchy groups are instead SHOULD NOT present. Fixture phrase empty rows/columns present must be understood as metadata definitions.

claim_assessments.assertion: Column/row names are alphanumeric, case-sensitive and nonduplicating; avoiding filesystem case collisions is SHOULD.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate well path is exactly row/column with no extra dirs, plus zero-based indices agreeing with it.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Well images list is actual field inventory; FOV paths are unique case-sensitive alphanumeric strings; multiple acquisitions require matching integer acquisition.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Per-field acquisition key required when multiple acquisitions performed in plate.

claim_assessments.assertion: field_count is only recommended maximum, not actual field census; well.images is authoritative for existing fields.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported navigation inference. Phantom pagination is hypothetical risk, not observed behavior.

claim_assessments.assertion: labels container is not itself an image; its child label images are images implementing multiscales.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Discovery must not list label images as images; classifying multiscales as image is wrong.
claim_assessments.reason: Source explicitly says label images are images. Separating auxiliary labels from the primary-image chooser is a reasonable product choice, but the source does not prohibit listing them as images or make any multiscales=>image inference intrinsically false. Hierarchy role and source association need preservation.

claim_assessments.assertion: multiscales is a list of dictionaries, each describing a multiscale image.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: datasets is mandatory; every entry has group-relative path; declared highest-resolution-to-lowest order is authoritative.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: All levels have same dimension count <=5, matching axes order.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Single/multiple multiscale selection paragraph suggests one/first fallback and user name choice; lack of RFC keywords makes its normative status uncertain.
claim_assessments.reason: Qualified: descriptive assertions may be normative without keywords. Pseudocode is illustrative; optional chooser can be adopted as a product convention. Source does not mark entire preceding prose informative.

claim_assessments.assertion: Pyramid level heuristic is unspecified; on-screen pixel vs level shape/chunk size is a proposed product rule.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct inferred choice, unexecuted. It does not guarantee nonuniform per-axis reduction or unavailable declared level handling.

claim_assessments.assertion: General coordinate transforms have a mandatory type and support identity/scale/translation, but multiscales restricts scale/translation.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Coordinate transforms map discrete data coordinates into declared coordinate space.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Transformations apply sequentially in listed order.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each dataset must have exactly one scale.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Scale is physical pixel/time size when available; otherwise relative to first resolution per axis, with 1.0 if no downsampling.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: At most one optional translation follows scale and shifts the origin in physical coordinate units.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Scale and translation vectors equal axes length.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional group-wide transforms obey same rules and apply after each dataset transform.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Example has per-level spatial voxel scales 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 micrometer and group-level time scaling of 0.1 milliseconds.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported as informative example interpretation; not universal reductions.

claim_assessments.assertion: Calibrated readout should use full composition, missing-unit handling, per-axis relative-factor fallback, time scale and offsets; real-writer conventions are unverified.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct proposal. A concrete asymmetric numeric composition check is not supplied.

claim_assessments.assertion: omero example provides channel color/window/active/label and rdefs initial time/plane/model rendering hints.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported exposure to example fields, not universal guarantee.

claim_assessments.assertion: omero optional; if present requires channels dictionaries.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each omero channel requires six hexadecimal RGB color string.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Channel window requires min/max/start/end.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: active/label/family/inverted/coefficient/rdefs occur only in example; presence is not mandatory and rendering math not algorithmically specified in this capture.
claim_assessments.reason: The suggestion presence is likely is an unmeasured expectation, not demonstrated prevalence; only optionality is supported.

claim_assessments.assertion: Version history re-adds omero description at 0.5.1, signaling specification change but not universal reader dependency.
claim_assessments.reason: Re-added supports a prior absence in description. Does not prove any particular tool behavior.

claim_assessments.assertion: 0.5 reader should support both transitional keys with fallback, treated as enrichment rather than hard dependency.
claim_assessments.reason: Reasonable product recommendation, not an established per-key normative SHOULD for every conforming reader. Section 9 acknowledges this uncertainty.

claim_assessments.assertion: Absent omero requires product decisions about gray/palette/LUT/windows; honoring rdefs or index zero and color/composite/grayscale is a convention.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported proposals, unexecuted; rdefs index bounds and model math are not guaranteed by example.

claim_assessments.assertion: labels group is nested beside resolution arrays; intermediate groups allowed but no metadata; label-image names arbitrary.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: labels group must contain a path array; all images SHOULD be listed.
claim_assessments.reason: Detailed section preserves SHOULD completeness. Summary MUST list label paths must not be interpreted as MUST list every label.
governing_conditions: Array required; exhaustive label inventory SHOULD.

claim_assessments.assertion: Same-or-one label dimension shape is a guarantee a viewer can rely on.
claim_assessments.reason: Cited hierarchy comment says should and does not make universal matching/broadcast shape a hard guarantee. It is weaker than the report guarantees heading asserts.

claim_assessments.assertion: Label images must implement multiscales and have equal level count to original unlabeled image.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported count requirement; original source must be resolved, not assumed to be any containing parent.

claim_assessments.assertion: Level-count parity and shape guarantees support per-level aligned overlays without verifying each label level coordinate relationship.
claim_assessments.reason: Equal number of levels does not establish corresponding geometry. S003 explicitly says same dimensions/transforms usually, not invariably. Label and original may have different scales/translations. The report lacks registration validation or unsupported-geometry policy.

claim_assessments.assertion: Label pixels are integer types uint8/int8/uint16/int16/uint32/int32/uint64/int64; noninteger labels are invalid.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: image-label as a whole and its colors/version are SHOULD; colors must be an array and version a string when supplied.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Recommended keys may be absent; value type requirements apply when supplied.

claim_assessments.assertion: Colors entries require integer label-value; rgba optional but must be four integers 0–255; readers SHOULD use specified colors.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: rgba optional; recommendation uses colors that are supplied.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional properties entries require integer label-value and can have arbitrary differing key sets; details/tooltip use is a product choice.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional source object may contain relative image string defaulting to ../../; link can confirm the original source image, especially out of context.
claim_assessments.reason: Relative association fact is retained, but defaults do not invariably resolve to the containing primary image when intermediate groups exist. Confirming association is only worth using in the report, not a pre-overlay admission gate.
governing_conditions: source optional; image optional; supplied image must be relative path string.

claim_assessments.assertion: Worked example associates 0 with blue rgba [0,0,128,128] and 1 with green [0,128,0,128], about half opacity.
claim_assessments.reason: Exposure to example values supports this account, not required palette or exact rendering formula.

claim_assessments.assertion: Missing image-label/rgba has unspecified display color; fallback coloring and metadata UI need a product choice.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported product inference; no universal transparent-zero rule is invented.

claim_assessments.assertion: Zarr v3 chunking enables chunk-based partial/random reads.
claim_assessments.reason: Capture mentions chunk grids/encodings but does not include actual Zarr I/O semantics or measured reader capability. Treat as by-reference architectural expectation, not implementation verification.

claim_assessments.assertion: Background reads/cancellation/responsiveness have no OME format prescription; arbitrary chunk features/codecs must not be assumed as a single fixed implementation.
claim_assessments.reason: Complete source read confirms absence of prescribed performance targets. Chunk-size pseudocode hint exists but is not a performance guarantee.

claim_assessments.assertion: Version/rank/names/label dtype/JSON/plate identity violations support an error taxonomy; UX and reject/tolerate behavior remain product requirements.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct conditional proposals; no executed malformed-input handling is claimed.

claim_assessments.assertion: Implementations section is only See Tools; no tool list or actual compatibility behavior can be established from admitted source.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct scope limitation. Future filesets/tools in validation are proposed new inputs, not current observed capabilities.

claim_assessments.assertion: Full OME-XML, UDUNITS-2 and OMERO WebGateway semantics are not in the capture.
claim_assessments.reason: Complete source read confirms scoped absence.

claim_assessments.assertion: Capture cannot establish dimension_names/omero prevalence or real writer scaling conventions; format clause and example are consistent with per-axis physical/fallback interpretation.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported limitation; known risk is a hypothesis about possible field variation, not empirical evidence.

claim_assessments.assertion: Cover date differs from last listed revision date and version/draft URLs coincide; some catalog aliases lack origin URL; currentness beyond capture unverified.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct observations; date difference alone is not proof of defect or actual future edition status.

claim_assessments.assertion: Any code keyed on names or filesystem ordering rather than metadata is a correctness defect.
claim_assessments.reason: Qualified: source specifically requires consecutively named collection groups in a conditional fallback, and relative paths necessarily name locations. Wrong inference from arbitrary level/axis names is the real defect, not all use of names.

claim_assessments.assertion: Proposed tests cover collection discovery, dense/sparse plates and labels nesting, level order/dimension names/named fallback, physical/group/time/missing-unit/offset calibration, omero/default display, label parity/colors/dtype, malformed metadata and future real-tool interop; all are UNEXECUTED.
claim_assessments.reason: Valid proposals as proposals. Overlay geometry, exact categorical precision/resampling, absent-vs-singleton controls, missing declared levels and concrete noncommuting numeric case are omitted.

claim_assessments.assertion: Future validation proposes acquiring current bioformats2raw/ome-zarr-py/ngff tool files outside admitted scope.
claim_assessments.reason: Unexecuted sourcing lead; not proof of current tools or supported format capabilities. No additional sources were admitted.

claim_assessments.assertion: Printed index maps source headings/ranges to conventions, storage, axes/collections/transforms/multiscales/omero/labels/plate/well, naming, implementations and history.
claim_assessments.reason: Checked all listed ranges against captured headings; index is an exposure map, not independent semantic support.

eligible_facet_coverage.reason: v3 and attributes.ome/version admission are explicitly identified and mixed-version invalid input is called out/tested. Universal all-node metadata namespace misstatement is separately graded.

Rank/order/arbitrary names/dimension_names and absent optional axes are covered; present singleton versus absent navigation dimensions and exact array-to-control size mapping are not. Custom/null axis display remains open without explicit unsupported admission.
omitted_subscope: Navigation counts/coordinates from array shape through validated identity
Explicit policy for ambiguous spatial/custom axes

eligible_facet_coverage.reason: Declared paths/order and per-level transforms are retained; no fixed factor-two mandate. Missing declared level handling is not identified explicitly, and nonuniform/anisotropic reductions are not tied concretely to selected-level geometry.
omitted_subscope: Nonuniform/anisotropic reduction check linked to level-specific geometry

eligible_facet_coverage.reason: Correct composition/order/offset/relative-factor and missing-unit treatment; no concrete noncommuting numeric coordinate check exposing reversal or omitted offsets.
omitted_subscope: Concrete asymmetric numeric composition and translation expected result

eligible_facet_coverage.reason: Discovery/hierarchy/parity and relative source link exposed. Registration is incorrectly assumed supported by level-count/shape guarantees; no per-level coordinate relationship validation, authoritative source resolution or truthful unsupported-geometry result.

Per-level registration using both image and label transforms

eligible_facet_coverage.reason: Integer dtypes and label-value keyed colors/properties are retained; palette remains SHOULD. Exact large integer range/lookup/refusal and category-preserving interpolation/resampling omitted.

Explicit policy for ambiguous spatial/custom axes

current_assertion_scope.unexecuted_tests: All section 10 fixtures/checks remain proposals. No execution result is asserted.
current_assertion_scope.unavoidable_history_exposure: Header exposes treatment-r1/Z task token; report says a source index was used and refers to Goal. No index/history/transcript is supplied or accessed.

useful_supported_novelty.description: Collection series/XML/plate precedence and HCS path/index/sparse metadata rules go beyond six-facet key.
field_count is recommended maximum; actual per-well field inventory comes from well.images.
Source capitalization and examples are interpreted with broad normative/descriptive conformance rule.
Optional omero mandatory floor and absent-input defaults distinguished; real-tool and external schema/performance limits acknowledged.

unresolved_matters: Candidate auxiliary-index use, no-fetch/no-write/no-execution and execution authorization are process claims inaccessible at current-only stage.
Named-selection normative status is not settled merely by absence of uppercase RFC keywords.
No actual tool behavior/prevalence or real-fileset performance available within admitted capture.
blinding_limitations: Header contains t06-z-ome-dev1-treatment-r1, an unavoidable condition/repetition cue; auxiliary index/Goal mentions also expose report format/process hints. No private treatment map, method cards, conversations, economics or other grades were read.
One coherent pair reviewed in one evaluator context: each conclusion grounded in admitted source, without model agreement.
Host requested model/effort binding confirmed; effective runtime is not independently exposed.

current_report_verdict.reason: Complete current-only review finds false overlay/shape/metadata/example assertions, unsupported reader/UI mandates and five partial eligible facets. One facet is full; missing current scope is not repaired by proposed tests.

false_claims.reason: Eligible C02–C06 are only partially addressed and material overlay/requirement claims fail. Complete deliverable status overstates current quality and scope.

false_claims.assertion: Multiscales and omero blocks contain the only worked examples.
false_claims.reason: Labels, plates and wells have explicit worked examples in the same captured document; the only assertion is false.

false_claims.assertion: Every node metadata lives in zarr.json under attributes.ome.
false_claims.reason: Only OME metadata is placed under attributes.ome. Zarr node metadata such as zarr_format/node_type, and array dimension_names, is not asserted to live there; intermediate labels groups must be metadata-free. Universal every-node wording conflates Zarr metadata with OME metadata.

false_claims.assertion: Same-or-one label dimension shape is a guarantee a viewer can rely on.
false_claims.reason: Cited hierarchy comment says should and does not make universal matching/broadcast shape a hard guarantee. It is weaker than the report guarantees heading asserts.

false_claims.assertion: Level-count parity and shape guarantees support per-level aligned overlays without verifying each label level coordinate relationship.
false_claims.reason: Equal number of levels does not establish corresponding geometry. S003 explicitly says same dimensions/transforms usually, not invariably. Label and original may have different scales/translations. The report lacks registration validation or unsupported-geometry policy.

source_exposure_vs_meaning: Titles, example fields, index entries and by-reference Zarr capabilities are exposure only unless governing captured prose supports the emitted meaning; relevant distinctions are explicit in rows.
no_candidate_rescue: Frozen report bytes unchanged; evaluator wrote assessments only.

inventory_audit.comment: Physical-line audit supplements semantic atomic inventory; a mapped line can have several independently assessed assertions.
